description: TCP-connect scan a host for open ports, plus network intel on the host's resolved IPs (ASN, network owner, BGP prefix, country — via Team Cymru). Defaults to a list of ~20 common service ports (SSH, HTTP/S, mail, DBs, etc.) if none are given. For checking your own infrastructure's exposure — capped at 100 ports per call.

host.description: Hostname or IP to scan (no scheme)

ports.description: Specific ports to check. Defaults to a common-ports list. Max 100 ports per call.

name: check_open_ports
